parameters.content:
## 1 · Web form intake
Code checks the form before any AI call: required fields, hidden spam field, duplicate within 24 h, injection patterns. The form gets its answer right away.

## 2 · Lead replies to our questions
Gmail trigger. Only replies in a thread where we asked questions are taken; everything else is ignored. The reply joins the original request and is scored again.

## 3 · Facts by the model, tier by code
Haiku only extracts facts with exact quotes. Code checks every quote and compares budget and deadline with the service catalog: HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW / ATTENTION.

## 4 · Pipedrive CRM
Every lead becomes a person, organization and deal. The agent writes only its own fields and stages; deals already in manager stages get a note only.

## 5 · Drafts (Sonnet)
High: reply + call brief (note and call task in Pipedrive). Medium: 2-3 questions about the missing data. A code guard flags prices, dates, promises and links.

## 6 · Manager card, save, log
Nothing is sent to a lead from here. The card goes to Telegram; every lead is saved to the sheet with cost; any failed step sends an alert and the lead still goes through.

## 7 · Manager actions (Telegram)
Send, Edit, Later, Not a lead, Queue AI call, reroute from Attention, Nudge, Close. An email leaves only after a button press; a failed send keeps the deal stage unchanged.

## 8 · Daily digest 09:00
Counts by tier, postponed and low leads, AI cost; Medium leads silent for N business days get a card with Nudge / Close.

## 9 · Crash alert
Unexpected failures of the whole run: Telegram alert + row in the errors tab.

## 0 · Setup Pipedrive (run once, manually)
Creates the "Inbound leads" pipeline, its stages and the AI deal fields if missing, then writes their ids into the settings tab.
